title: Proposal Generation, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Proposal Generation agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 8 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Proposal Generation RFPS list.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including Digital Transformation Platform (RFPId meridian), with ID RFP-2024-0147.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Proposal Generation Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 6 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 8 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Bid Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Analyze the synthetic Meridian Healthcare RFP and show the traceable requirement checklist.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: RFP Analysis; Requirements Analysis; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Account Executive
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Draft an executive summary for the synthetic Meridian Healthcare opportunity that reflects the buyer priorities and remains subject to review.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Executive Summary; Personalization Applied; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.prompt: Compare the synthetic solution and pricing assumptions for Meridian Healthcare without approving a price, discount, or concession.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Solution & Pricing; Budget Analysis; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.

steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: References & Competitive Positioning; Win Theme; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Bid Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Outline the synthetic Meridian Healthcare proposal package and every human review required before delivery.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Proposal Package; Required Human Review Before Delivery; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Sales Leader
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Summarize the synthetic Meridian Healthcare draft readiness and the decisions authorized reviewers must make next.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Delivery Summary; Human-Governed Next-Step Options; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Proposal Generation: 8 read-only tabs from the same lists. 3 fictional records, including Digital Transformation Platform (RFPId meridian), with ID RFP-2024-0147.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Proposal Generation RFPS from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload rfps.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set RFPId, ID, Account, Industry, KeyStakeholder, CompetitorsShortlisted, ExistingAssets to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Use Multiple lines of text for Requirements (up to 543 characters). If the import screen cannot create these long-text columns losslessly, stop and report the import limitation; do not continue with truncated records. Compare their full values with the downloaded CSV. Keep DealValue, BudgetCeiling, DecisionTimelineDays as Number. Name the list Proposal Generation RFPS. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including Digital Transformation Platform (RFPId meridian), with ID RFP-2024-0147.

steps.title: Create Proposal Generation Product Catalog from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload product-catalog.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ProductCatalogId, Category to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep ListPrice, MarginFloor as Number. Name the list Proposal Generation Product Catalog. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 6 fictional records, including Platform Core License (ProductCatalogId platform_core), with ListPrice 420000.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Proposal Gen Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there.
steps.expected: The studio instructions name the 8 list tools and map every Title and field_N column.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_proposal-generation-operating-rules.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the rfps tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Proposal Generation RFPS; name the tool Get rfp records.
steps.expected: Get rfp records is listed under Tools.

steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: proposal-generation-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 8 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Proposal Generation Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Proposal Generation RFPS" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Proposal Generation Product Catalog" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Proposal Generation Solution Configs" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Proposal Generation Discount Rules" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Proposal Generation References" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Proposal Generation Competitor Capabilities" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Proposal Generation Our Capabilities" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Proposal Generation Impl Phases" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 8 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Proposal Generation Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Proposal Generation RFPS tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 3 fictional records, including Digital Transformation Platform (RFPId meridian), with ID RFP-2024-0147.
